source_brief:
Create a CNC aluminum motor mount with a 90x60x8mm base plate, four corner M5 screw mounting holes, and a central 22mm through hole for the motor shaft.
Use R6 outer corner fillets and a C1 top-edge chamfer. Add one lightening pocket on each side and chamfer all hole mouths.
Deliver a SolidWorks part and STEP file, with preview review.

tap_drill_reference.note: The current mounting holes are clearance through holes; use this tap-drill reference when tapped holes are required.

features.name: OuterCornerFillet
features.fallback: If fillet solving fails, reduce to R4 or apply one edge at a time.

features.name: TopEdgeChamfer
features.fallback: If the full-perimeter chamfer fails, group edge objects and retry.

features.name: SideLighteningPockets
features.fallback: If a pocket conflicts with the center or mounting holes, reduce or omit it and record the change.

assumptions: The four mounting holes use a rectangular pattern with a 10 mm edge offset.
Mounting holes are through clearance holes; use a threaded_hole feature if tapped holes are required.
Lightening pockets retain at least 3 mm wall thickness and 2 mm floor thickness.

risk_register.risk: Fillets and chamfers may fail or take too long after complex hole and slot cuts.
risk_register.mitigation: Follow the CNC subskill order: finish outer fillets/chamfers before cutting holes and slots; on failure, reduce the radius and retry edges individually.

risk_register.risk: Hole-mouth edge selection may be unreliable.
risk_register.mitigation: Enumerate body.GetEdges(), match the center, radius, and top-face height, then select the edge object with edge.Select2().

risk_register.risk: SaveAs may fail when the output file is already open in SolidWorks.
risk_register.mitigation: Close same-name task-owned prior documents before execution, then check file existence and size after saving.

solidworks_mapping.notes: Manage the document lifecycle through the session.
Keep base sketches simple; avoid beginning with complex filleted outlines.
Select edge objects rather than relying on Edge1 or coordinate picks.
Generate previews from multiple views and a review report.
